text:
Robert Alvarez
14 Ashgrove Court, Boulder, CO 80301
robert.alvarez@example.com
(303) 555-0199

Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in the Data Platform Engineer
position at Meridian Analytics Corp, which I learned about through a
former colleague on your infrastructure team. Over the past six years
I have built and operated large-scale data pipelines, most recently
leading a migration that cut our nightly batch processing time by
half.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in
distributed systems could contribute to Meridian Analytics Corp's
data platform roadmap. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Robert Alvarez
